evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: Je vertaalt data naar heldere rapporteringen en dashboards die de business ondersteunen bij strategische beslissingen.
evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: The JD is generic recruiter language with no explicit governance/testing signals and no explicit speed/velocity signals either, so mixed by default absence of a clear 2x signal either way.
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: The listed industry (Environmental Services) and generic internal BI/reporting responsibilities carry limited, recoverable consequences with no financial, regulatory, or safety-critical framing, so low.
evidence.data_team_maturity: Je werkt mee aan de migratie van een bestaand datawarehouse naar Microsoft Fabric.
evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: An existing data warehouse to migrate and named tools in responsibilities (Microsoft Fabric, Power BI) indicate a functioning, growing data setup, but no dedicated data team or sub-teams are described.
evidence.jd_authorship: Voor een stabiele en technologisch vooruitstrevende onderneming in regio Zuid-West-Vlaanderen zijn we op zoek naar een BI Analist/ Data Engineer.
evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: Generic recruiter-style framing (unnamed 'stable and technologically forward-thinking company' in the region, no specific scale/volume numbers or methodology) typical of an agency posting (Maxicon is a staffing/recruitment agency) despite some concrete tool names.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation: Je integreert data uit verschillende bedrijfsapplicaties tot één betrouwbare informatiebron.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: The role's central focus is building the internal data platform/warehouse and reporting layer itself, an internal_data orientation, with only generic reference to 'the business' as a downstream consumer.
evidence.autonomy_level: Je denkt actief mee over de verdere uitbouw van het dataplatform en de data-architectuur.
evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: Mix of scoped technical execution (developing/optimizing data models and pipelines, migrating an existing warehouse) and some architectural input (actively co-thinking about platform/architecture direction).
evidence.ai_role_explanation: No mention of AI anywhere in the JD.
evidence.testing_framing: No testing or data quality signal.
evidence.testing_framing_explanation: The JD never mentions testing, data contracts, or a data quality framework.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing_explanation: The JD is framed entirely in delivery/capability terms (migration, developing models, dashboards) with no risk, compliance, or reliability register.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix: Je werkt mee aan de migratie van een bestaand datawarehouse naar Microsoft Fabric.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix_explanation: Mix of migrating/fixing an existing data warehouse and building out new data models, pipelines, and future data architecture.
